mapper.select: select id, openid, phone, nickname, subscribe, subscribe_time, unsubscribe_time, distributor_id, bind_time, bind_source, user_id from wx_mp_user where openid = #{openid} limit 1
select id, openid, phone, nickname, subscribe, subscribe_time, unsubscribe_time, distributor_id, bind_time, bind_source, user_id from wx_mp_user where phone = #{phone} limit 1
mapper.update: update wx_mp_user set phone = #{phone} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, order_no, phone, customer_name, car_no, amount, status, verify_status, verify_time, verify_msg from wx_biz_order where order_no = #{orderNo} limit 1
select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where phone = #{phone} and status = '1' and date(send_time) = #{date}
select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where status = #{status}
select * from wx_mp_template_msg where biz_id = #{bizId} limit 1
select * from wx_mp_template_msg where msg_id = #{msgId} limit 1
select * from wx_qr_scene where scene_id = #{sceneId} limit 1
select * from wx_qr_scene where scene_str = #{sceneStr} limit 1
select * from wx_dist_member where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
select * from wx_mp_template where template_id = #{templateId} limit 1
select * from wx_ledger_item where biz_no = #{bizNo} and ledger_type = #{ledgerType} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into wx_dist_commission (order_no, customer_phone, customer_openid, beneficiary_id, beneficiary_name, commission_amt, ratio, points, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{customerPhone}, #{customerOpenid}, #{beneficiaryId}, #{beneficiaryName}, #{commissionAmt}, #{ratio}, #{points}, #{status}, 'SYSTEM', sysdate())

insert into wx_ledger_item (ledger_no, ledger_type, biz_no, phone, openid, amount, points, direction, biz_user, status, occurred_time, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{ledgerNo}, #{ledgerType}, #{bizNo}, #{phone}, #{openid}, #{amount}, #{points}, #{direction}, #{bizUser}, #{status}, #{occurredTime}, 'SYSTEM', sysdate(), #{remark})
insert into wx_qr_scan_log (scene_id, biz_type, scene_str, openid, is_new_follow, scan_time) values (#{sceneId}, #{bizType}, #{sceneStr}, #{openid}, #{isNewFollow}, #{scanTime})
mapper.select: select p.*, c.company_name, ct.contact_name, ct.phone as contact_phone, t.type_name from jonlink_product p left join jonlink_insurance_company c on p.company_id = c.id left join jonlink_contact_person ct on p.contact_id = ct.id left join jonlink_insurance_type t on p.type_id = t.id where p.id = #{id}
select * from jonlink_settle_record where direction = #{direction} and ledger_id = #{ledgerId} limit 1

select (select count(*) from wx_mp_user) as fans, (select count(*) from wx_mp_user where subscribe = '1') as fans_active, (select count(*) from wx_biz_order) as orders, (select count(*) from wx_biz_order where verify_status = '1') as verified, (select ifnull(sum(amount),0) from wx_biz_order where verify_status = '1') as verified_amount, (select count(*) from wx_ledger_item where ledger_type = '1') as ledger_verify, (select ifnull(sum(points),0) from wx_ledger_item where ledger_type = '2') as dist_points, (select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where status = '1') as msg_sent, (select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where status = '2') as msg_failed, (select ifnull(sum(premium),0) from jonlink_insurance_ledger) as ledger_premium, (select ifnull(sum(profit),0) from jonlink_insurance_ledger) as ledger_profit, (select count(*) from jonlink_insurance_ledger) as ledger_count, (select count(*) from jonlink_insurance_ledger where up_settle_status = '1') as ledger_up_settled, (select count(*) from jonlink_insurance_ledger where down_settle_status = '1') as ledger_down_settled from dual

select date(verify_time) as d, count(*) as cnt, ifnull(sum(amount),0) as amt from wx_biz_order where verify_status = '1' and verify_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date(verify_time) order by d asc

select ledger_date as d, count(*) as cnt, ifnull(sum(premium),0) as premium, ifnull(sum(profit),0) as profit from jonlink_insurance_ledger where ledger_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by ledger_date order by d asc
select ledger_type as type, count(*) as cnt, ifnull(sum(amount),0) as amt from wx_ledger_item where date(occurred_time) = #{date} group by ledger_type
mapper.insert: insert into wx_ledger_summary (stat_date, ledger_type, total_count, total_amount, create_time) values (#{ledgerDate}, #{ledgerType}, #{count}, #{amount}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update total_count = values(total_count), total_amount = values(total_amount), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update wx_biz_order set status = '1', update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
update wx_biz_order set verify_status = #{verifyStatus}, verify_time = #{verifyTime}, verify_msg = #{verifyMsg}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
update wx_mp_user set distributor_id = #{distributorId}, bind_time = #{bindTime}, bind_source = #{bindSource} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from wx_dist_member where parent_id = #{parentId}
mapper.update: update wx_dist_member set accum_points = accum_points + #{points}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into wx_mp_template (template_id, template_id_short, title, content, keyword_order, primary_industry, deputy_industry, example, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{templateId}, #{templateIdShort}, #{title}, #{content}, #{keywordOrder}, #{primaryIndustry}, #{deputyIndustry}, #{example}, #{status}, 'SYSTEM', sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from wx_mp_user) as fans, (select count(*) from wx_mp_user where subscribe = '1') as fans_active, (select count(*) from wx_mp_user where date(subscribe_time) = curdate()) as fans_today, (select count(*) from wx_mp_user where subscribe_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 month)) as fans_month, (select count(*) from wx_biz_order where verify_status = '1' and date(verify_time) = curdate()) as verify_today, (select ifnull(sum(amount),0) from wx_biz_order where verify_status = '1' and date(verify_time) = curdate()) as verify_amount_today, (select ifnull(sum(points),0) from wx_ledger_item where ledger_type = '2' and date(occurred_time) = curdate()) as points_today, (select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where date(send_time) = curdate()) as msg_today, (select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where status = '2' and date(send_time) = curdate()) as msg_failed_today, (select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where status = '0' and date(create_time) = curdate()) as msg_pending_today, (select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where status = '1') as msg_sent_total, (select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where status = '2') as msg_failed_total, (select ifnull(sum(amount),0) from wx_biz_order where verify_status = '1' and verify_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 month)) as verify_amount_month, (select ifnull(sum(points),0) from wx_ledger_item where ledger_type = '2') as points_total, (select count(*) from wx_qr_scan_log where date(scan_time) = curdate()) as scan_today, (select count(*) from wx_qr_scan_log) as scan_total, (select ifnull(sum(profit),0) from jonlink_insurance_ledger where ledger_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 month)) as profit_month from dual

select date(occurred_time) as d, count(*) as cnt, ifnull(sum(case when direction = '0' then amount else 0 end),0) as amt_in, ifnull(sum(case when direction = '1' then amount else 0 end),0) as amt_out, ifnull(sum(points),0) as pts from wx_ledger_item where occurred_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date(occurred_time) order by d asc
select ledger_type as type, count(*) as cnt, ifnull(sum(amount),0) as amt from wx_ledger_item group by ledger_type order by cnt desc

select ledger_no, ledger_type as type, phone, openid, amount, points, direction, status, date_format(occurred_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as occurred_time, biz_user, remark from wx_ledger_item order by id desc limit #{limit}

select s.id, s.scene_id, s.biz_type, s.scene_str, s.openid, s.is_new_follow, date_format(s.scan_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as scan_time, ifnull(u.nickname, concat('粉丝', right(s.openid, 4))) as nickname, ifnull(u.city, '未知') as city from wx_qr_scan_log s left join wx_mp_user u on u.openid = s.openid order by s.id desc limit #{limit}

select (select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where status = '2' and date(send_time) = curdate()) as push_failed_today, (select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where status = '0') as push_pending, (select count(*) from wx_mp_template_msg where status = '0' and date(create_time) < date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 day)) as push_expired, (select count(*) from jonlink_insurance_ledger where up_settle_status = '0') as settle_up_pending, (select count(*) from jonlink_insurance_ledger where down_settle_status = '0') as settle_down_pending, (select count(*) from wx_biz_order where verify_status = '0') as order_unverified, (select count(*) from wx_qr_scan_log where scan_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 24 hour)) as scan_24h from dual
select ifnull(city, '未知') as name, count(*) as cnt from wx_mp_user where city is not null and city != '' group by city order by cnt desc limit #{limit}
select notice_id as id, notice_title as title, notice_type as type, date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as create_time from sys_notice where status = '0' order by notice_id desc limit #{limit}

select (select count(*) from wx_biz_order o where o.phone = (select u.phone from wx_mp_user u where u.openid = #{openid})) as total_orders, (select ifnull(sum(o.amount),0) from wx_biz_order o where o.phone = (select u.phone from wx_mp_user u where u.openid = #{openid})) as total_amount, (select count(*) from wx_biz_order o where o.phone = (select u.phone from wx_mp_user u where u.openid = #{openid}) and o.status = '0' and o.verify_status = '0') as pending, (select count(*) from wx_biz_order o where o.phone = (select u.phone from wx_mp_user u where u.openid = #{openid}) and o.verify_status = '1') as done, (select count(*) from wx_biz_order o where o.phone = (select u.phone from wx_mp_user u where u.openid = #{openid}) and date(o.create_time) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 month)) as month_orders, (select ifnull(sum(o.amount),0) from wx_biz_order o where o.phone = (select u.phone from wx_mp_user u where u.openid = #{openid}) and o.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 month)) as month_amount from dual

select date(o.create_time) as d, count(*) as cnt, ifnull(sum(o.amount),0) as amt from wx_biz_order o where o.phone = (select u.phone from wx_mp_user u where u.openid = #{openid}) and o.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date(o.create_time) order by d asc
select o.status as status, count(*) as cnt from wx_biz_order o where o.phone = (select u.phone from wx_mp_user u where u.openid = #{openid}) group by o.status

select order_no, customer_name, service_type, car_no, amount, status, verify_status, date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time from wx_biz_order where phone = (select u.phone from wx_mp_user u where u.openid = #{openid}) order by id desc limit #{limit}
select openid, phone, nickname, avatar, sex, city, activity_level, remark, date_format(subscribe_time,'%Y-%m-%d') as subscribe_date from wx_mp_user where openid = #{openid} limit 1
